description: Execute any local read-only tool from Spica Post’s extended catalog discovered via tools_search (such as links_list, inbox_list, articles_list, templates_list, brands_overview, approvals_list or export_*). Refuses mutating or external-network tools (use tools_run for those). Changes nothing.

args.description: Arguments matching the target tool’s parameters from tools_search (pass brandId at top level).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tool.description: Exact local read-only tool name from tools_search (e.g. "links_list", "inbox_list", "articles_list", "templates_list", "brands_overview").

name: tools_read

result.description: Delegated tool result object or list.

title: Run a read-only catalog tool
